title: Fixing an audience doesn't reach leads a paused campaign already enrolled
hypothesis: Resuming a paused campaign after fixing its audience sends the fixed lines.
change: Checked each paused campaign's Activity tab and lead ids against Audiences.
result: Every enrolled lead showed as Unknown lead: 140 per campaign enrolled Sep 29 from since-deleted records. Resuming would have sent to 128 orphaned queued leads each, and none of the new lines reach them.
next_decision: Relaunch as a new campaign on the fixed audience instead of resuming.
check: Before resuming, read who is enrolled and whether their records still exist; a changed audience means relaunch.
